metadata.title: 10-year Treasury hits 2007 high as oil stays above $100: AlphaCheck

content.text:
Good morning. Stocks fell on Tuesday as oil prices stayed solidly above $100 per barrel ahead of the Federal Reserve's key policy meeting this week.
Brent crude futures (BZ=F) rose to $105 per barrel, raising concerns about persistent inflation.
The 10-year Treasury (^TNX) rose as high as 5.04%, its highest level since 2007, after breaching the 5% threshold on Monday.
Investors expect Fed policymakers to raise rates on Wednesday following their 2-day policy meeting.
Here's a check of the markets in the first few minutes of trading, based on a heat map powered by Yahoo Finance AlphaSpace data.
Tech stocks (XLK) gained as chip heavyweight (NVDA) led a rebound in semiconductors.
The move comes after AI titans Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) sounded the alarm about the risks of AI, calling for a slowdown in its development.
Bitcoin (BTC-USD) declined as a long-awaited procedural vote on the crypto-related Clarity Act was set to take place on Tuesday afternoon, with the market assigning a 30% chance that the bill would get the 60 votes needed to proceed.
Here are some other notable stocks that Yahoo Finance readers are viewing this morning: Bank of America (BAC), Coinbase (COIN), and Nebius Group (ZScaler).
